messages:
nina: Opening a thread for a small docs PR: migrating a couple of console observability examples to metrics_v2. Found three blockers during example rendering: a broken playground link, an absent trace_key in YAML, and an out-of-date cost field in SDK snippets.
harry: drop PR link when ready, I'll take the redirect.
ci-bot: PR opened by @nina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5251 - examples job failed: renderer TypeError: trace_key expected str, got None.
lee: converter dropped null fields; for trace_key we should emit an explicit empty string. Also span_sampling changed from boolean to object recently.
docs-bot: Suggested immediate replacement for dead link: https://console.redwood.ai/playground. Filed infra ticket REDW-1401 for redirect.
nina: repro snippet in PR: ```yaml
presets:
  - name: kv-latency-heatmap
    metrics_schema: 'v1'
    tracehook:
      trace_key: null
      span_sampling: true
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency_p95
```
lee: propose v2 conversion: ```yaml
presets:
  - name: kv-latency-heatmap
    metrics_schema: 'v2'
    tracehook:
      trace_key: ""
      span_sampling:
        strategy: probabilistic
        rate: 0.01
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency.p95
        cost_mode: normalized
```
harry: I'll patch the dead URL and follow up on SDK snippets renames (cost_per_token -> unit_cost.tokens). Add a TODO to the PR description to run the examples smoke tests locally.
nina: added checklist and manual render steps to the PR. CI re-run queued.
ci-bot: CI re-run triggered by @nina.
lee: reviewed and approved after a tiny wording nitfix in the migration note.
nina: merged. Follow-ups: REDW-1402 sweep SDK repos for `cost_per_token` rename, REDW-1401 infra redirect. Thanks team :tada:
